title: The roots power map gives the degree-one coefficient comparison
statement: Let m,mprime>0 with m dividing mprime. Let A be a commutative ring killed by both m and mprime, let T be a scheme on which mprime is invertible, and let q:mu_mprime -> mu_m be an abelian sheaf morphism satisfying q followed by the kernel inclusion equals (mprime/m) times the source kernel inclusion [def-asd-etale-roots-of-unity]. For the coefficient lines [def-asd-finite-etale-tate-twist] there is an isomorphism e:A_T,mprime(1) -> A_T,m(1) sending each sheafification generator a tensor z on every etale object W to a tensor q(z). This statement concerns only degree one, with q supplied and normalized; it asserts no signed power, tensor, dual or derived comparison.

source.place: Tag 03PK section-kummer and Tag 03EK; parent original step 9

proof.text: Use a primitive mprime-root cover from the cyclic trivialization. Write k=mprime/m. The subgroup of ZMod mprime killed by m is k times ZMod mprime, identified with ZMod m by i |-> ki. Thus if zeta generates mu_mprime, zeta^k generates mu_m. The normalized q must be the power map since the kernel inclusion is monic.

source.place: Tag 03PK, section-kummer; finite scalar extension and signed powers

proof.text: The power map in these two bases is reduction ZMod mprime -> ZMod m, sending the first chosen generator to the second. Its scalar extension to A is the identity of A, since both exponent maps to A factor through the smaller modulus. Consequently it is invertible locally and hence globally; the pure-tensor prescription descends and gives the stated equality after sheafification.

theorem finiteEtaleTwistExponentLine (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A]
    (m m' : ℕ) (hm : 0 < m) (hm' : 0 < m') (hdiv : m ∣ m')
    (hA : (m : A) = 0) (hA' : (m' : A) = 0) (T : Scheme.{u})
    (hT : IsUnit (m' : Γ(T, ⊤)))
    (q : T.rootsOfUnitySheaf m' ⟶ T.rootsOfUnitySheaf m)
    (hq : q ≫ kernel.ι (m • 𝟙 T.gmSheaf) = (m' / m) • kernel.ι (m' • 𝟙 T.gmSheaf)) :
    ∃ e : finiteEtaleTateLine T m' A hA' ≅ finiteEtaleTateLine T m A hA,
      ∀ (W : T.Etaleᵒᵖ) (a : A) (z : (T.rootsOfUnitySheaf m').obj.obj W),
        e.hom.hom.app W (finiteEtaleTateOneGenerator A m' T hA' W a z) =
          finiteEtaleTateOneGenerator A m T hA W a (q.hom.app W z)
